name: Marcus
label: Ambitious and stalled
headline: Marcus, ambitious and stalled
summary: 22-ish coach in a money niche. His first launch crushed it and every launch since sells less. Two agencies burned him, so he trusts nobody in his DMs.

points.name: Trauma
points.sum: Burned twice by agencies, his launches keep shrinking, and his family still thinks it's a pyramid scheme.
lines: Burned by agencies: Spent $2K on a YouTube growth agency that got views but zero sales. Spent $1,500 on a "funnel expert" who built a 0% converting funnel and ghosted.
Launch plateau: First cohort sold 8-12 seats ($28K-$45K). Second launch sold 2-3 seats ($6K-$9K). Third launch sold 3-4 seats ($10K-$15K). Realized his warm audience is tapped out.
DM'd by trash operators: Gets 5-10 DMs/week from newbies promising $50K+/month with fake guarantees or no proof. Makes him jaded and skeptical of everyone.
Family/friend doubt: Parents told him quitting his job was a mistake. Friends laughed. Even after his first $35K launch, some still think he's in a pyramid scheme.
Competitor resentment: Watches people with worse skills make $200K-$500K/month consistently while he's stuck doing $15K-$30K most months.
Wasted money on courses: Spent $1,000+ on courses that delivered nothing.
Had to borrow money: Had a $8K month once and had to borrow $1,500 from parents to cover rent. The shame still haunts him.

points.name: Obstacles
points.sum: His warm audience is tapped out, revenue swings month to month, and he doesn't trust anyone to fix it.
lines: Launch plateau: First cohort sold well (drained warm audience). Now launches get 2-4 seats max. Needs cold traffic system.
Warm audience tapped out: Everyone who was going to buy already bought. Needs NEW people but doesn't have a system to bring them in.
Stuck at $10K-$30K/month from industry work: Decent, but nowhere near the $100K-$200K+/month he wants.
Feast and famine: Some months $40K-$50K, most months $15K-$25K. Can't predict revenue.
No consistent sales flow: Scrambling every month hoping clients show up.
Content doesn't convert anymore: Posts get engagement but no qualified leads.
Kills momentum constantly: Posts 10 days when desperate, ghosts 2-3 weeks when burnt out.
Copies leaders without understanding why: Doesn't realize authority beats format.
Doesn't see YouTube as long-term asset: Tried 5 videos, got 500 views, quit. Thinks it doesn't work for high-ticket.
No clear positioning: Bootleg brand, no unique micro-niche.
Been burned by operators: Paid $2K and $1,500 to trash agencies. Now skeptical of everyone.
Kicks the can down the road: Knows he needs help but treats hiring someone as a last resort because he doesn't trust anyone.
Doesn't see the value in $5K-$10K investment yet: Knows good service costs that much but hasn't seen proof it's worth it.
Fucked sleep schedule, no routine: Some nights up until 3 AM, other nights crashes at 9 PM. No consistency.
